general.title: General information to Asset Administration Shell and OPC UA

runs.text: An Asset Administration Shell is the standardized digital representation of an asset. It carries the asset's identity and references the submodels that describe it, such as a nameplate, technical data, a carbon footprint or a bill of material. Submodels are identified in their own right and may be referenced by more than one shell.

Shells, submodels and concept descriptions carry globally unique identifiers. Other elements are named within their parent by a short name and are addressed by the path of short names that leads to them.

An OPC UA Client browses live shells and submodels, reads or writes submodel element values with the standard Services, and invokes an AAS operation through AASOperationType.Invoke.

A registry Client discovers shells and submodels, retrieves versioned documents and AASX packages, and follows federated references while preserving entity identity and applying the target resource's disclosure and authorization policy.

A product-passport implementation exposes public and controlled AAS content through one registry, retrieves historical revisions, and serves an environment document filtered to the calling Session's permissions.
